notes: Method: critic-hobb.md gives NO row indices. Its section 6 item 1 says 'verify every skipped claim whose rule is SINGLE SOURCE (2, 7, 8, 10, 16, 25, 27, 46, 49, 51) or whose witness is a named professional critic (Bear x5, Shilling x3, Langford 1995 x3, Heck x5, Kelly x4, Dray x3, Landon x3, Pulley x3, Erikson x2). About sixty rows'; its section 3 names the section-A cure as 'Heck (5 rows), Bear (5), Elliott (29) and the census (21) - all in the SKIPPED_TRIAGE pile'. The rows below were resolved by grouping the 152 SKIPPED_TRIAGE rows of state-hobb.json by their source field: every one of the critic's per-witness counts reproduced exactly (Bear 5 = [521-525], Shilling 3 = [551-553], Langford SFX #4 3 = [577-579], Heck 5 = [588-592], Kelly 4 = [571-574], Dray 3 = [538, 539, 541], Landon 3 = [548-550], Pulley 3 = [535-537], Erikson 2 = [575, 576], Elliott 29, census 21), which is the cross-check. CONFIRMED by script. INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN, and the chair must know it: the other half of item 1 - skipped claims whose SECTION RULE is single-source - cannot be resolved from the state, because rows carry the finder's sixteen coarse buckets, not the section's rule numbers. The critic's own bucket-to-rule map (section 3, counts CONFIRMED against the state) is: 'civic record register' 45 skips = rules 2, 7, 27; 'point of view and distance' 19 = rule 16; 'place and institution description' 16 = rule 25; 'consequence on a household' 14. The bucket rows are: civic record register [523, 525, 549, 554-557, 595, 602, 621-631, 633-635, 641-643, 646, 649-651, 653, 655-657, 661, 665, 666, 673, 679-681, 689, 692, 694, 695]; point of view and distance [530, 541, 546, 550, 575, 576, 593, 596, 601, 604, 605, 614, 619, 636, 662, 664, 675, 686, 691]; place and institution description [527, 543, 553, 565, 569, 572, 577, 578, 647, 668, 670, 676-678, 682, 690]. A re-triage keyed by section rule (which the critic asks for and which needs the section text, not the state) would add roughly thirty rows to the 81 below to reach the critic's 'about sixty' for item 1. Ranges expanded: 521-525, 551-553, 571-574, 577-579, 548-550, 535-537, 588-592, 622-637, 676-680. Rows named that are NOT SKIPPED_TRIAGE: none. Two further census rows, [621] and [638], are SKIPPED_TRIAGE and are the same finder's census, but carry distinct source strings ('over the 314 entries' and 'over the full 541-post corpus') and fall outside the critic's count of 21; they are NOT in rows and a census verification pass should pick them up. Likewise [692] (Elliott's Fedwren Project bibliography) is a skipped Elliott row outside the 29. Oliver's own 15 skipped rows ([554-559, 561, 681-688]) are deliberately excluded: Oliver is the sole source rules 2, 8 and 21 already stand on, so more Oliver does not cure the single-sourcing, and the critic's cure list does not name them. Rows the critic names that are not triage skips and so are not here: [640] is NOT_FOUND (the census counts cited to a tag page that cannot carry them - the critic gives it the sweep/epi/ REST route); [466] and [482] are kept-but-uncited rows (section 2), not skipped; [603], [606], [616] are BLOCKED caption rows, not skipped.
